tasks.title: Code failure logger module — scripts/lib/code-failure-logger.ts

Use only stdlib: crypto (randomUUID), fs, path.

tasks.title: Fix generate-sprint-brief.py — derive last sprint number from git log
tasks.description: Modify scripts/generate-sprint-brief.py. Add a function get_last_sprint_from_git(project_root: Path) -> Optional[int] that runs: result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', '-30'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(project_root)) then parses each line with re.search(r'Sprint (\d+):', line) and returns the highest sprint number found. In generate_brief(), call this after config is loaded. If it returns a value, use it as the authoritative last sprint number and set next_sprint = last + 1. Insert these two values into the brief output under 'Recent Sprint History' as: '- LAST sprint number completed: Sprint {last_git}' and '- NEXT sprint number needed: Sprint {next_sprint}'. If git call fails or returns None, fall back to existing progress.md parsing. Keep the change under 40 lines. Import subprocess and re at the top if not already imported.
